model.name: R19.55: Devices become first-class scenario units (ior:class:Device) in the scenario index.
model.description: Each Device MUST be a first-class scenario unit (ior:class:Device) stored at scenario/index/<shard>/<deviceUuid>.scenario.json with the standard {ior, model, ownerIor} shape (ownerIor = the User unit that owns the device), unitLinks[], and statusChecklist. Migrate existing data/devices.json entries into per-device scenario units (backup-gated). After migration, code reads/writes device data via scenario units; devices.json becomes deprecated/derived. Includes: (a) ior:class:Device class definition, (b) server code reads/writes via scenario units, (c) one-time migration (backup before).
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "users and devices still have to be converted to standard first class scenarios."
model.crossRefNote: R19.54 (User as scenario unit) is the sibling — same Tron directive, same pattern. Device.ownerIor points to its User unit.
